units.translation: And this Aegina lies toward the south wind
the supine body of the fallen father
he lies, the destroyer of this woman
he lies, the lover of this man
and you lie in this spider's web
seeing this man lying in the woven robes of the Erinyes
you will lie in the same tomb
many things—and well placed out of the way
up, indeed, house, for far too long you have lain always on the ground
you boast this word to one not yet laid low
and the good things of friends lying far away, that is, the good dwelling-places in a foreign land
(with aorist ἔκερσα and ἐκερσάμην, which the grammarians attribute to the Aeolic dialect) I cut off, shear
may not Ares, the deadly bedfellow of Aphrodite, shear off the flower
there is no one except one who could cut it (the lock of hair)
but not even the woman who killed him cut it
(as if from a present κάζω) adorned, equipped
not to bring any man well equipped with a spear
when he came from his mother and made a noise
the clamor from the Greeks sounded in song
and in my ears cries a clamor not of healing
and he will feast on the black-eaten liver
and the black recess of Hades rumbles beneath the earth
you will come to the black race
and may he hurl his body headlong into black Tartarus
the king of birds—the black one and the one with white behind
lull the bitter might of the black wave
if there is any black hiding-place somewhere
and my inward parts (thus Schuetz for μου) grow black
but my black-hearted mother killed him
Thus I corrected for μελανόχρως [black-skinned] (κελαινόχρως [black-skinned] Pauw) δὲ πάλλεταί μου καρδία [and my heart leaps].
and my black heart leaps with the surge
having traversed the end of the long road
to go on the midday road
you rushed along the coastal road
hasten back on the road by which you came
not to disgrace the passage of the long road
through the plains of Thrace and the wintry roads
the vision has gone, not later, on wings, following the paths of sleep
to strew the ground of the road with coverings
guests spending the day from a long journey
the meeting of three roads of the split path, where we exchanged the junctions of the three Potnian roads
in time this road will capture the city of Priam
and having founded a life to be turned back upon in the paths of children
